# Feature index entry

Keep `docs/features.md` as an index of capability names and relevant source files. Add or update a table row when code entry points change.

Use descriptive names and file links. Do not add Feature, issue, AC or Task IDs, acceptance matrices, delivery history or copied behavior rules to the index.

Detailed requirements, design and verification belong to the current request or issue. Read existing code, contracts and tests before changing behavior. Do not create separate Feature or spec files for routine work.
